prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 常用中药方剂组成与主治简表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "方名" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 2: header "组成" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 368px
  col 3: header "功效" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 138px
  col 4: header "主治" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 1195px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"简要对照常用中药方剂的组成、功效与主治，帮助读者按方名查找并比较。","reading":"读者先按方名定位，再横向阅读药物组成、功效和主治；比较时也会纵向浏览相应列。主治文字最长，往往决定行高，其他列可在同一行内适度换行。","groups":["方名是行标识，与其后的组成共同说明方剂是什么。","功效和主治共同说明方剂的作用及适用病证，适合相邻比较；功效通常较精练，主治需要更多空间。"],"keep_intact":["方名尽量保持整词完整、单行呈现。","药名和病证名称尽量保持完整，避免在名称中间断开。"],"may_wrap":["组成可在药名之间的顿号处分行。","功效可在语义短语之间换行。","主治可按标点和语义自然换行，并为同一行的其他列提供换行空间。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [98, 195, 130, 296] · table 720×686px · row heights [36, 60, 83, 106, 83, 83, 129, 106] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [98, 210, 125, 286] · table 720×686px · row heights [36, 60, 83, 106, 83, 83, 129, 106] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [98, 185, 155, 281] · table 720×733px · row heights [36, 60, 83, 129, 83, 106, 129, 106] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"方名保持单行，功效与主治相邻，横向查阅关系清楚。主治获得较多空间，长病证描述的行数得到控制，行与行之间的节奏比较稳定。","problems":"组成列中多处药名被拆到两行，如“炙甘草”“大枣”和“川芎”；补中益气汤的组成也形成较零碎的三行。功效列中较长的短语需要换行。","cause":"组成列宽195px，扣除内边距后不足以让部分行末药名完整落在同一行；功效列宽130px，较长功效短语无法完整单行显示。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"组成列比r1A宽，麻黄汤、四君子汤和四物汤的组成各可单行显示，药物列表更易扫读；主治虽略窄，整体行高仍与r1A相同。","problems":"组成列仍有药名跨行，如六味地黄丸的“泽泻”和补中益气汤的“柴胡”。功效列的较长内容换行略显局促，主治中的部分短语也在行尾被切开。","cause":"组成列宽210px仍无法容纳所有行末药名；功效列收至125px、主治列收至286px，使这两列的换行更紧。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"功效列较宽，短功效清晰，较长功效也有更多横向空间；方名单行，列间关系清楚。","problems":"组成列换行明显增多，多处药名跨行，六味地黄丸和小柴胡汤尤其零碎。主治的部分段落比其他方案多一行，行高因此增加，表格纵向节奏较松散。","cause":"组成列缩至185px，文本可用宽度只有164px；主治列为281px，部分长描述因此多换一行。功效列增至155px所占空间对多数短功效的收益有限。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2A","widths":[98,220,120,281],"change":"以r1B为基础，再给组成列10px，尝试减少行末药名拆分；功效略缩，主治保持可读宽度，观察较长功效和主治是否因此增加行高。"},{"name":"r2B","widths":[98,205,120,296],"change":"保留r1B较宽的组成列，同时把主治恢复到r1A的296px；从功效列和组成列各取少量空间，测试能否兼顾药名完整性与长病证描述的流畅度。"},{"name":"r2C","widths":[98,225,110,286],"change":"尝试更偏重组成的分配：把组成加宽至225px，功效缩至110px，主治保持r1B宽度。用于检验药名完整度的改善是否值得功效列增加换行。"}]}
